description: Review an initial Nix package against the repository's packaging conventions.

criteria.requirement: The review identifies packages/opencode2/default.nix as dead and misleading because flake.nix discovers directories but calls each package.nix directly from the shared scope.
The review identifies the hand-written hashes and platform selection in package.nix as duplicating the repository's platformSource helper and explains the maintenance consequence.

The review notices that opencode2 advertises and updates x86_64-darwin even though the flake's supported systems omit that platform, and asks for the package metadata and updater to derive from the supported source platforms.
The review notices that versionCheckHomeHook already supplies a writable HOME, under which the client can use its default XDG paths, making the package's manual HOME and XDG setup redundant.
The candidate inspects the repository and patch without modifying or committing the reviewed checkout.
The final response leads with concrete findings, gives useful file and line references, and explains each consequence without padding or a generic summary.

calibration.name: middling
calibration.comment: Authored reference, not a historical response. The findings it does make follow the upstream follow-up commit 2aca632c, which acted on all four; this subject omits the last one.
